issue_context.title: [systemd-networkd] dhcp failed to configure route
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
 > systemd-247.1

systemd-246.6 works fine on the same host (the only difference is systemd version), also `dhcpcd` works fine with both versions (but I don't use it).

**Used distribution**
 > Archlinux x86_64

**Linux kernel version used** (`uname -a`)
 > Linux node2.bkoty.ru 5.9.11-zen2-1-zen #1 ZEN SMP PREEMPT Sat, 28 Nov 2020 02:08:52 +0000 x86_64 GNU/Linux

**CPU architecture issue was seen on**
 > x86_64 (kvm, VPS)

**Expected behaviour you didn't see**
 > network interface configured and default route is added.

**246.6**:
```
$ ip -4 addr
...
2: ens3: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP group default qlen 1000
    altname enp0s3
    inet 195.201.98.54/32 scope global dynamic ens3
       valid_lft 84779sec preferred_lft 84779sec
$ ip -4 route
default via 172.31.1.1 dev ens3 proto dhcp src 195.201.98.54 metric 1024 
172.31.1.1 dev ens3 proto dhcp scope link src 195.201.98.54 metric 1024
```

**Unexpected behaviour you saw**
 > address is added but no route.

**247.1**:
```
$ ip -4 addr
2: ens3: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP group default qlen 1000
    altname enp0s3
    inet 195.201.98.54/32 scope global dynamic ens3
       valid_lft 86374sec preferred_lft 86374sec
$ ip -4 route
```
(yes, last command outputs nothing.)

**Steps to reproduce the problem**
 > (Not completely sure): (?VPS, ?kvm), getting IPv4 from DHCP server,
